description: Steps from 3 documented incidents in which AI agents acted against real systems, placed on MITRE ATT&CK® Enterprise v20.0. 65 of 84 attack steps have a technique and are shown; the rest have none. Red: no public AI control side task has that technique. Amber: some public task has it. Untested does not mean undefended, and no monitor has been run. The incidents were chosen because they are well documented; they are not a random sample. Draft: all labels were drafted by an AI. No human has reviewed any label yet. Not affiliated with or endorsed by The MITRE Corporation.
